d:
Birsa Munda ki maut ka rahasy kya hai, Ranchi jail men 9 jun 1900 ko haija huaa tha ya jahar diya gaya tha ? is video men dharti aaba Birsa Munda ki puri kahani hai, Ulihatu ke bachpan se ulgulan, Dombari Buru, giraphtari, jail ke aakhiri 20 din aur CNT Act taka. ye video itihas ki kitabon, us daur ke sarkari kagjon aur Munda samaj ki yad par tika hai, aur jahan kitaben alag bat kahti hain vahan donon baten rakhi gaee hain.
